note: The four week-one architecture items live in the vertical slice epic (18) because they must land immediately.

tickets.title: Seed + genVersion world reproduction
tickets.description: A few hundred bytes reproduces a bit-identical world. Terrain never replicates — the foundation of everything else here.

tickets.title: In-world player messages
tickets.description: Exact-position, unlike Souls, because geometry matches across everyone on the seed.

tickets.title: Death markers per seed
tickets.description: A danger map the community generates for free.

tickets.title: Annotated map sharing
tickets.description: The genuinely novel one — sharing your player-authored map of a seed with someone walking the same continent.

tickets.title: Featured seeds
tickets.description: 'This week's world' as a shared topic. An open-world RPG makes a poor speedrun leaderboard.

tickets.title: Host-authoritative co-op session layer
tickets.description: Post-launch. Guests bring character and inventory only, keep no world progress. Dissolves the 'whose consequences' question.

tickets.title: Co-op difficulty: add enemies, never inflate health
tickets.description: Health scaling makes lethal low-TTK combat spongy and destroys the 'one bandit is dangerous' contract.

tickets.title: Downed-and-revive state with a real cost
tickets.description: Spent charges, lost cargo, world-clock time. Not a free pickup.

tickets.title: DECISION: co-op handling of catalogue uniques
tickets.description: OPEN. Instancing breaks the 'sixty unique items exist in this world' premise; contesting causes friction. Current lean: single-instance with host priority or a party roll.

tickets.title: Guest first-join local forge with caching
tickets.description: A guest pays a one-time local forge instead of a 400MB download.
